docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Dutt’s English translation of Kāmandaka’s Nītisāra, the verse digest of the Arthaśāstra on kingship, counsel, alliance and war (Calcutta, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Kamandakiya Nitisara; or, The Elements of polity, in English · Kamandaka, Dutt, Manmatha Nath · 1896, 262 scanned pages. Published 1896; Manmatha Nath Dutt died 1912; the text is ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
